verdict.rationale: AFK's AI breaks goals into a directed graph of workflow steps and acts across connected tools like Mercury, Gusto, Carta and Stripe. Reads run automatically and writes pause for approval, so there is AI-driven tool use within a workflow. However, the AI is the built-in planner/executor. Nothing shows a user adding their own AI agent or LLM steps to a workflow, or choosing a model. Missing for 10: user-configurable AI/LLM step insertion, model selection, configurable per-step tool use, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
